name: Red phoenix tail
description: White fuselage. A red fin with Capital Airlines' gold phoenix (a stylised bird's head and swept feathers); the red runs down over the rear fuselage to the belly, edged in front by a gold sweep that leaves the crown well ahead of the fin and curves down into the red, with fine gold feather lines in the white under it. Forward, the small red phoenix, the Chinese name 首都航空 in black brush lettering and 'Capital Airlines' in black italic above the windows. White engines.

sources.title: 20230821 Airbus A330-243 of Beijing Capital Airlines (B-8549) at SYD (CC BY-SA 4.0, Windmemories)
sources.note: A330-200 B-8549 taxiing at Sydney, left side, level, 2023-08-21. Fitted to shapes/A332.json (doors within 17 px): the red and gold sweeps read column by column, the titles' ends and heights, the logos.

sources.title: 20250407 Airbus A330-243 of Capital Airlines (B-8019) taxiing at SYD (CC BY-SA 4.0, Windmemories)
sources.note: Right side, 2025-04-07: the same scheme from the right (phoenix nearest the nose, then the Chinese name reading right to left, then 'Capital Airlines'); the red and gold sweeps as on the left.

areas.name: gold sweep from the crown ahead of the fin, curving down into the red
red from the fin down over the rear fuselage to the belly

titles.style: The Chinese name in black brush (calligraphic) characters above the forward windows, behind the phoenix; on the right side it reads right to left (空航都首), nose-first.
Black bold italic sans above the windows, behind the second door.

logos.description: Capital Airlines' phoenix in gold on the red fin: a stylised bird's head with a crest, facing forward, above sweeping feathers.
A small red phoenix ahead of the Chinese name, behind the forward door.
Fine gold feather lines fanning through the white under the gold sweep, ahead of the red.

notes: Measured on B-8549 (A330-200, left side, Sydney, 2023-08-21) fitted to the A330-200 shape; B-8019 (right side, 2025) agrees. The red's front edge runs from the crown at x 0.755 down to the belly at x 0.886, the gold sweep's lower edge from the crown at x 0.658 to where it meets the red at about x 0.85, below the window line. Many of Capital's A330s carry a name in large Chinese characters along the cabin (B-8549 唐拉雅秀号, B-8019 江西金控号) and sponsors' marks (TANGLA); these are per aircraft and not drawn. The HNA badge under the cockpit isn't drawn. The right side's Chinese name reads right to left on the aircraft; a renderer setting it left to right, as the spec's right-side rule does, shows it reversed from the aircraft. The A320s wear the same scheme. The A330-200 freighter B-32MG wears a different, white-tailed scheme (cargo.json).
history: New 2026-11-21 (the maintainer's sightings: B-32MG, which turned out to be a freighter in its own scheme, cargo.json).
